observations: elongate cylindrical body with a broad flattened head and small dorsolateral eyes
olive-brown mottling with irregular oblique darker upper flank bars
long low soft dorsal and anal fins without a spiny front
rounded tail, small rounded pectorals and gentle travelling body flex
